title: Northern Ireland managers in order
brief: Name Northern Ireland's ten managers from Danny Blanchflower (1976) to Michael O'Neill's second spell, in order. Each place is labelled with the year he took charge; Michael O'Neill had two spells and fills two places.

notes.Dave Clements: Dave Clements (1975 to 1976) came just before Blanchflower.
notes.Billy Bingham: Billy Bingham also managed from 1967 to 1971, before this period.
notes.Michael O'Neill: Michael O'Neill was appointed in December 2011 (first match February 2012) and returned in December 2022.

checks: Wikipedia's manager history (updated to 8 June 2026) and Transfermarkt's staff history list the same managers in the same order with no caretakers in this period. Labels are the year each took charge (Transfermarkt's start dates): O'Neill's first spell is labelled 2011, when he was appointed, though his first match was in February 2012. O'Neill was still in post in July 2026.
